title: DEMO: Wi-Fi sign-in checklist
text: Confirm the device Wi-Fi is enabled. Check that it is connected to the intended network. Forget the network, reconnect, and check the account sign-in flow. If connectivity still fails, contact support.
steps: Forget and reconnect to the network.
If it still fails, escalate to a support lead.

title: DEMO: No internet after connection
text: A laptop can show connected but lack internet. Restart the wireless connection and verify whether the issue affects other devices. Ask a support lead if it persists.
steps: Check whether another device has working internet.
Escalate if the connection continues to fail.

title: DEMO: Game console network setup
text: Some game consoles require device registration or a supported network setup. Verify official registration requirements and the device hardware address using current IT documentation. Escalate if unsure.
steps: Check the official network instructions for game consoles.
Locate the console's network hardware address if requested by official instructions.
Escalate if the console still cannot connect.

title: DEMO: Smart speaker setup
text: Smart speakers may have wireless-network limitations. Check the supported device policy and official onboarding instructions. Do not tell students to purchase routers without checking policy.
steps: Check the device model and supported-network policy.
Escalate unsupported devices to a lead.

title: DEMO: Printer connection
text: Printers may need wireless or USB setup. Consult current departmental instructions. Do not assume every printer supports the same connection type.
steps: Confirm the printer model and connection method.
Check current approved printer setup documentation.
Escalate if the device is unsupported.

title: DEMO: Scope and escalation
text: For requests outside support scope, explain the limitation and refer the student to the appropriate support lead. Never invent a guaranteed fix.
steps: Explain that the issue may be outside the team's support scope.
Ask a support lead for an approved referral.
